description.narrative: Contribute to improved IWRM in rural areas in collaboration with Water Agencies (AE), Local Water Committees (CLE), municipalities and farmers' cooperative organisations to increase access to clean, sufficient and safe water. ECDD-GIRE is a demand driven peer to peer support project for improved of IWRM. In this consortium project Wwn, Agriterra, AUXFIN share knowledge, best practices and facilitate implementation in the field of sustainable water management and efficient water useECDD Gire consists of two components.Component 1: Capacity building in IWRM and local governance supported by digital technologiesThis component focuses on training on water management techniques at the level of water user committees (CUEs) and rural agriculture cooperatives, women's and youth groups (by Agriterra) and digitised in a digital tool "WaterCoach" (AUXFIN). Objectives of this subprogram: people trained in SMART water farming practices, conflict sensitivity, human rights based approach, gender and social inclusion and implementation of plans. WWn, Agriterra and AUXFIN work with practical educators and innovators to ensure grassroots empowerment.Component 2: Improve the qualitative and quantitative management of water resources for all uses and usersThe objective of this component is to provide operational support and training to communities in the implementation of local IWRM by implementing best practices and support to cooperatives and farmers for climate SMART solutions to reduce water use and water pollution from agricultural practices.

ECDD-GIRE is a demand driven peer to peer support project for improved of IWRM. In this consortium project World Waternet, Agriterra, AUXFIN share knowledge, best practices and facilitate implementation in the field of sustainable water management and efficient water use for agriculture. World Waternet carries out the consortium coordination with Agriterra and AUXFIN and overall management and support of project activities.

description.narrative: As part of the start-up phase of the ECDD-GIRE (2024-2029), the WWn, Agriterra and Auxfin consortium undertook several activities and studies. These included the stakeholder analysis, the baseline study, the strategic environmental assessment and the Gender and Social Inclusion assessment. These are working documents that help to realistically plan the results to be achieved on time, and to identify potential gaps and elements that need to be added and modified as the project is implemented. In addition, the results of the studies and evaluations have been used to refine the objectives, hence this Inception report, the proposed activities and budget for the 2025 annual work plan. This Inception report highlights i) the internal and external organisation for good governance of the project, ii) the different strategies that will be developed for digitalisation, the choice of CUE, cooperatives and the successful implementation of activities on the ground, taking into account environmental assessment, appropriate communication, gender and social inclusion, iii) the monitoring, evaluation and capitalisation mechanism for all project activities.
